Beds.Name: South bed
Beds.Notes: Tomatoes went in late — watch for blight if we get a wet June.

Beds.Name: North bed
Beds.Notes:
## What worked last year

Kale survived the frost without any covering. Chard bolted early — sow later next time.

## Plan for this year

- Sow chard in late April instead of March
- Try a cut-and-come-again mix in the gaps
- Add a layer of compost before planting out

General notes:
## Soil

pH around 6.5, tested March 2026. Added a bag of well-rotted manure to each bed.

## Watering

Drip irrigation on the south bed is working well. North bed still hand-watered — consider extending the system this summer.
